svg.title: From one story to a client-ready kit
svg.desc: Proposed assistant workflow: Joei supplies authorised material; Echo preserves the voice; Moss prepares activities and Folio prepares the edition; Joei reviews; Sunny prepares the client handoff. Four portable prompts are included; no agents run inside this infographic.

g.text: Your voice starts the work. Your review decides what leaves the studio.
